method: Rendered exact hosted newsletter.html. Before publishing, only remote asset requests were fulfilled using identical local bytes listed in asset-manifest.json. Fresh screenshots generated from this HTML hash and all eleven full-email contact sheets visually reviewed.
checks: Readable text widths and intact words
Natural photo proportions and original photo ordering
All primary CTA rectangles at least 54px tall and fully linked
Every product image remains its own complete linked tap target
Three-column image-only lookbook remains intact without head styles
No dash punctuation in customer-facing text or alt text
remainingBeforeSending: Send a fresh Omnisend phone test and inspect the received email
scope: GitHub asset package, not a sent campaign.
